title: BrowseConf: Confidence-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Web Agents
authors_zh: Litu Ou、Kuan Li、Huifeng Yin、Liwen Zhang、Zhongwang Zhang、Xixi Wu、Rui Ye、Zile Qiao、Yong Jiang、Pengjun Xie、Fei Huang、Jingren Zhou
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: BrowseConf uses verbalized confidence to stop/retry web-agent rollouts.
BrowseConf 用模型自述的置信度决定网页智能体的采样何时停止、何时重试。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: A per-rollout trace field controls interactive allocation and memory.
inclusion_reason: Confidence directly controls web-agent retry, stopping, and trace reuse.

title: Problem
问题
html: Fixed-budget test-time scaling gives every web query the same number of costly agent attempts, even when the first answer is likely sufficient. BrowseConf asks whether an agent's verbalized confidence after a long sequence of search, visit, reasoning, and observation steps can route additional attempts. The relevant record is an attempt-level trace containing the query, actions and observations, final answer, self-reported confidence, attempt index, carried-over context, stop decision, and evaluation outcome. Confidence is a model-produced control signal, not a correctness label or calibrated probability by default.

固定预算的测试时扩展会为每个网页查询分配相同数量的高成本 agent 尝试，即使第一次回答可能已经足够。BrowseConf 研究：经历多轮搜索、访问、推理与观察后，agent 的口头置信度能否用于决定是否继续尝试。相关记录是尝试级轨迹，包含查询、动作与观察、最终答案、自报置信度、尝试序号、跨尝试保留的上下文、停止决策和评测结果。置信度是模型生成的控制信号，默认既不是正确性标签，也不是经过校准的概率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Each attempt produces an answer and an integer confidence score from 0 to 100. A threshold chosen on a 500-item SailorFog-QA validation subset triggers another attempt when confidence is too low; execution stops when the threshold is met or after at most ten attempts, then returns the highest-confidence answer if the budget is exhausted. BrowseConf-Zero restarts from scratch. BrowseConf-Summary carries a structured summary of evidence, contradictions, unresolved reasoning, and promising URLs. BrowseConf-Neg carries previous low-confidence answers as negative constraints. Correctness is used for evaluation and threshold analysis, not supplied online as a verifier during deployment.

每次尝试都会输出答案和 0–100 的整数置信度。阈值在 SailorFog-QA 的 500 条验证子集上选择；若置信度过低则继续尝试，达到阈值或最多完成 10 次后停止，预算耗尽时返回置信度最高的答案。BrowseConf-Zero 从头重启；BrowseConf-Summary 传递包含证据、矛盾、未完成推理与潜在 URL 的结构化摘要；BrowseConf-Neg 把此前低置信答案作为负约束。正确性只用于评测和阈值分析，部署时不会作为在线 verifier 反馈给 agent。

title: Method
方法
html:
The study evaluates gpt-oss-120b and DeepSeek-V3.1 on BrowseComp and BrowseComp-zh. The web harness exposes Google search, returning ten titles/snippets/URLs per query, and a visit tool that extracts pages with Jina before a summary model selects goal-relevant content. Inference uses temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, and a 128k context limit. A context-overflow attempt is assigned confidence -1; the three variants handle that failed attempt differently. Baselines include Pass@1, oracle-style Pass@10, ten-sample self-consistency, and confidence-weighted self-consistency.

A reusable trace needs the validation-set revision and threshold-selection rule; per-attempt answer, confidence, token and interaction counts; search queries, returned URLs, page snapshots, visit objectives and summaries; previous-answer or trajectory-summary context; stop reason; chosen answer; and judge outcome. The paper and metadata do not establish a public code/data package, immutable web snapshot, complete query/action logs, or per-run seeds, so those artifacts remain unknown or unavailable.

论文在 BrowseComp 与 BrowseComp-zh 上评估 gpt-oss-120b 和 DeepSeek-V3.1。网页 harness 提供 Google 搜索工具，每个查询返回十条标题、摘要和 URL；访问工具先用 Jina 抽取页面，再由摘要模型选择与目标相关的内容。推理设置为 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95、上下文上限 128k。若某次尝试耗尽上下文，则置信度记为 -1，三个变体以不同方式处理该失败尝试。对照包括 Pass@1、oracle 式 Pass@10、十样本 self-consistency 和按置信度加权的 self-consistency。

可复用轨迹需要保留验证集版本与阈值选择规则；每次尝试的答案、置信度、token 和交互次数；搜索查询、返回 URL、网页快照、访问目标与摘要；此前答案或轨迹摘要上下文；停止原因、最终选择及 judge 结果。论文与元数据没有建立公开代码/数据包、不可变网页快照、完整查询动作日志或逐次运行种子，因此这些工件仍为 unknown 或不可得。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper first bins BrowseComp attempts by reported confidence. Both evaluated models are overconfident in an absolute sense—the 90–94 confidence bin reaches at most 53.33% accuracy—yet higher bins show substantially higher empirical accuracy, while scores below 70 are near zero. Main experiments compare accuracy and average attempts under a ten-attempt cap. BrowseConf variants use about 2.06–5.72 attempts on average rather than the ten required by fixed-budget self-consistency/CISC, with model- and benchmark-dependent accuracy tradeoffs. Threshold ablations show that stricter thresholds can improve accuracy but consume more attempts; carrying summaries or negative answers changes later interaction counts.

These are system-level calibration and routing results. They do not make a particular confidence score a ground-truth probability, verify the web evidence in an attempt, or certify any unreleased trace corpus. Pass@10 is an upper-bound-style metric requiring outcome knowledge and is not the deployed selection rule.

论文先按自报置信度对 BrowseComp 尝试分桶。两个模型在绝对意义上都明显过度自信：90–94 分区间最高只有 53.33% 准确率；但更高置信区间的经验准确率显著更高，低于 70 分时则接近零。主实验在最多十次尝试下比较准确率和平均尝试数。BrowseConf 各变体平均使用约 2.06–5.72 次尝试，而固定预算 self-consistency/CISC 使用十次；准确率取舍随模型和基准变化。阈值消融表明，更严格阈值可能提高准确率但增加尝试；传递摘要或负答案也会改变后续交互次数。

这些属于系统层面的校准与路由结果，不能把某个置信分数变成 ground-truth 概率，也不能验证某次尝试中的网页证据，更不能认证未公开轨迹语料。Pass@10 是需要结果知识的上界式指标，不是部署时的选择规则。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Verbalized confidence, self-consistency, confidence-weighted voting, restart-based test-time scaling, and web agents all predate BrowseConf. The distinctive contribution is to use a final attempt-level self-assessment as an online stopping/routing signal in a long-horizon browsing environment, then compare three memory policies: no carryover, summarized trajectory context, and explicit avoidance of earlier low-confidence answers. For trace curation, this exposes a useful linkage among attempt, confidence, carried context, retry decision, and selected output. It is a training-free allocation method and evaluation study, not a new confidence-labeled dataset, calibrated verifier, or RL training recipe.

口头置信度、self-consistency、置信度加权投票、重启式测试时扩展和网页 agent 都早于 BrowseConf。其区别在于把一次长程浏览尝试结束时的自我评估用作在线停止/路由信号，并比较三种记忆策略：不保留历史、传递轨迹摘要、显式避免此前低置信答案。对轨迹整理而言，它建立了尝试、置信度、携带上下文、重试决策与最终输出之间的关联。该工作是无需训练的算力分配方法与评测研究，不是新的置信度标注数据集、校准 verifier 或 RL 训练配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Verbalized confidence is systematically overconfident and its ranking quality can shift across models, languages, domains, prompt formats, tools, or web states. A threshold selected on SailorFog-QA may not transfer to BrowseComp or deployment traffic. High confidence can terminate on a wrong answer; low confidence can discard a correct one. Selecting the maximum-confidence answer after budget exhaustion further depends on relative, not absolute, calibration.

Summaries can omit or distort evidence and may anchor later attempts; negative constraints can suppress an answer that was actually correct. Repeated live-web attempts are not independent, and token/attempt counts omit some tool, summary-model, latency, and API costs. Evaluation uses LLM-as-a-judge following benchmark practice. Public code, full attempts, queries, page snapshots, summaries, rejected outputs, thresholds by model, licenses, decontamination, and replay manifests are not established by the Card and remain unknown.

口头置信度存在系统性过度自信，其排序能力也可能随模型、语言、领域、提示格式、工具或网页状态变化。在 SailorFog-QA 上选择的阈值未必能迁移到 BrowseComp 或真实流量。高置信可能让错误答案提前终止，低置信也可能丢弃正确答案；预算耗尽后选择最高置信答案依赖的是相对排序，而不是绝对校准。

摘要可能遗漏或扭曲证据，并使后续尝试产生锚定；负约束也可能压制其实正确的先前答案。多次实时网页尝试并不独立，token/尝试次数还没有覆盖全部工具、摘要模型、延迟与 API 成本。评测按基准惯例使用 LLM-as-a-judge。本卡未确认公开代码、完整尝试、查询、网页快照、摘要、被拒输出、逐模型阈值、许可证、去污染和重放清单，这些字段仍为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
BrowseConf is useful as a schema for adaptive-compute web-agent traces. An auditable record should retain query and benchmark split, attempt index, model and prompt revision, action/observation log, URL and page snapshot, final answer, confidence, prior-attempt context, threshold and validation provenance, retry/stop reason, selected answer, judge configuration, correctness, tokens, interactions, latency, and cost. These fields support calibration curves, early-stop audits, memory-policy comparisons, and counterfactual replay under alternative thresholds.

Confidence should be stored as a model claim alongside—not in place of—outcome and evidence checks. The benchmark results justify studying this routing signal; they do not show that generated attempts are high-quality training data or that confidence generalizes without recalibration.

BrowseConf 为自适应算力网页 agent 轨迹提供了记录模式。可审计记录应保留查询与基准划分、尝试序号、模型和指令版本、动作/观察日志、URL 与网页快照、最终答案、置信度、此前尝试上下文、阈值及验证来源、重试/停止原因、被选答案、judge 配置、正确性、token、交互次数、延迟与成本。这些字段可支持校准曲线、提前停止审计、记忆策略比较，以及在不同阈值下进行反事实重放。

置信度应作为模型主张与结果和证据检查并列保存，而不能替代后两者。基准结果说明该路由信号值得研究，却不能证明生成尝试是高质量训练数据，也不能证明置信度无需重新校准即可泛化。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate verbalized confidence, empirical correctness, and judge score; they are different signals.
  • Preserve every attempt and stop/retry decision, including low-confidence and context-overflow failures.
  • Record threshold-selection data and recalibrate by model, language, domain, prompt, and tool environment.
  • Audit summaries for lost citations and negative constraints for suppression of previously correct answers.
  • Compare policies using total model, tool, summary, latency, and API cost—not attempt count alone.

• 区分口头置信度、经验正确性与 judge 分数；三者是不同信号。
  • 保存每次尝试及停止/重试决策，包括低置信与上下文溢出失败。
  • 记录阈值选择数据，并按模型、语言、领域、指令和工具环境重新校准。
  • 审计摘要是否丢失引用，以及负约束是否压制此前其实正确的答案。
  • 比较策略时统计模型、工具、摘要、延迟与 API 的总成本，而不只看尝试次数。
